text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Ai-san. For giving me 
such a wonderful bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Very much so... I could really 
feel your sincerity, Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...A red bouquet represents passion and 
strength. It's a color full of energy, 
fitting for Ai-san, who never forgets to 
take on new challenges."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Not only that... but this time, you've 
mixed in some orange as well. It's a warm, 
soothing color, just like the sun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Flowers filled with passion and kindness. 
Ms. Ai's wonderful personality really 
shines through this bouquet, it truly—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm so sorry. Did I say something 
offensive?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because, really! This makes it feel like 
I'm the one being celebrated here! Jeez, 
let me make this crystal clear.
